slides.headline: BMW's F 450 GS Now Has 4 Variants

slides.stat_label: F 450 GS Sport, the New Fourth Variant
bullets: Gets the Trophy's sport suspension and Riding Modes Pro
No Easy Ride Clutch; only the Trophy has it
Same 48 hp, 420cc twin as the cheaper variants

slides.stat_label: Ex-Showroom Price of the Base F 450 GS

Exclusive: ₹5.55 lakh now, ₹4.90 lakh in April
GS Trophy: ₹6.15 lakh now, ₹5.30 lakh in April
